title: Spurs Draft Gillespie and Brown in 2026 NBA Draft
text:
The San Antonio Spurs selected guard Ja'Kobi Gillespie with the at No. 42 and forward Maliq Brown at No. 44 in the 2026 NBA Draft. Gillespie, an All-SEC guard from Tennessee, is described as an offensive spark plug and playmaker. Brown, from Duke, is noted for his seven-foot wingspan and ACC Defensive Player of the Year honors. These picks follow the team's trade for Tarris Reed Jr. and their selection of Jayden Quaintance at No. 20, as they look to support Victor Wembanyama.
NEW YORK, NEW YORK - JUNE 24: Maliq Brown is drafted 44th overall by the San Antonio Spurs in Round Two of the 2026 NBA Draft at Barclays Center on June 24, 2026 in New York City.
